fields.description: There should only ever be one index per DocType, therefore this will also serve as the name of the index.
fields.label: DocType

fields.description: Every non-Frappe field of the associated DocType. Check "Relevant for Deduplication" for every field you want included in the similarity search. Be aware that fields with low entropy, e.g. a single character field for gender, will not be prime candidates here.
fields.label: DocType Fields

fields.description: A higher number of permutation functions produces more accurate results but increases query cost.
fields.label: Number of Permutations

fields.description: The percentage of similarity that a document must minimally have to the one about to be created in order to count as a likely duplicate. Must be set at initialization of the index, therefore you'll need to create a new one if your chosen threshold produces too many false positives/negatives.
fields.label: Similarity Threshold

fields.description: The pickled index stored as a hexadecimal string
fields.label: Stored Index

fields.description: Deletes every record from the index, which will lead to a complete rebuild when the next document is validated.
fields.label: Flush Index
